blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 78 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 12, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & MRNA lead 78 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 24 Canadian and 54 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 12, 2026) found 78 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 24 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 8 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +95% six-month return, and Consumer Discretionary is the most represented sector with 4 names.

In the U.S., 54 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 10 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +393% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 22 names.
